Headline: Promoter Shares Of Himalayan Bank And Kamana Sewa Bikas Bank In Auction From Today
Full Content:
The existing promoter of
Himalayan Bank Limited (HBL)
is auctioning 4,28,540 units of shares to existing promoter shareholders from today i.e. 27th Bhadra, 2081.
4,28,540 units of promoter shares of HBL will be auctioned. Only existing promoters are eligible to bid for the auction within 35 days from this notice's publication date, i.e. 27th Bhadra. The shareholders should submit their bids at the bank's central office located at Kamaladi, Kathmandu.
If no bids are received from the existing founder shareholders by the mentioned date, then the shares will be auctioned to the general public later.
As of writing, HBL has an LTP of Rs. 245.90. Meanwhile, HBLPO has an LTP of Rs. 125.00.
Auction notice:
The existing promoters of
Kamana Sewa Bikas Bank Limited (KSBBL)
are selling 35,534 units of promoter shares in an auction to the promoter shareholders/qualified person/company/institutions from today i.e. on the 27th Bhadra to 2nd Ashwin, 2081.
35,534 unit promoter shares of KSBBL will be auctioned. Interested general public/institutions including eligible promoter shareholders can bid for the auction. Rs. 105 is the minimum bid rate. The minimum bid quantity for promoters’ shares is 35,534 units.
Prabhu Capital is the auction manager. Bids will open at the premises of the auction manager on Ashwin 4, 2081 at 11:00 AM.
As of writing, KSBBL has an LTP of Rs. 469.00.
